prompts.name: Sasuke Uchiha
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production facial-feature decal PNG for a 3D game character. Make ONE character's front-orthographic facial feature stencil on a genuinely transparent portrait canvas. Draw ONLY facial features: eyebrows when appropriate, eyes with opaque whites/irises/pupils, character-specific nose linework, mouth, and facial markings. All other pixels fully transparent. NO skin fill, NO face/head/jaw outline, NO hair, NO ears, NO headgear, NO neck, NO body, NO text, NO borders. Authentic Masashi Kishimoto / Studio Pierrot face: narrow serious almond eyes with strong black upper eyelids, small nearly-black charcoal irises and pupils, straight firm dark eyebrows, delicate angular nose ink, small unsmiling closed mouth with a subtle reserved expression. No Sharingan, no Rinnegan, no purple iris, no scars or whiskers. Sharp serious Sasuke face, not Goku and not a generic smiling anime boy.
